facts.title: Shidou balance
facts.text: Dragon Header distance −25%; Demon Drive distance −15% and no longer usable mid-air; Big Bang Drive distance −20%.

facts.title: NEL Shidou–Charles
facts.text: Charles uses Sky Arc Pass to NEL Shidou. Before the ball arrives, activate highlighted Dragon Header to trigger the chemistry.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Sae improvements
history.text: New V variant, Magical Turn returned, Divine Pass can trigger chemistry with Shidou. Perfection Shot gained 20% range and speed; i-frames added to Perfection Shot and Divine Pass.

history.title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
history.text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

history.title: July quality of life
history.text: New awakening bars, titles and Bachira MVP.

history.title: NEL Shidou–Charles chemistry
history.text: Sky Arc Pass highlights Dragon Header before the ball arrives; activating it triggers the chemistry. Shidou's effects and shot/dribble balance were adjusted.

history.title: Sae–Shidou chemistry polish
history.text: Sae's Perfect Pass to Shidou highlights Demon Drive as the ball approaches. Tournament scoreboard resets fixed.

history.title: NEL Shidou release
history.text: New NEL evolution quest and moveset, new Mythic Shidou cutscene move and World Tournament part two.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Otoya and game fixes
history.text: Dynamo Pass range +20%; Sneaky Volley speed and distance −20%; Kablamo gained i-frames. Similar ball-ring colors prevented on opposing teams.

history.title: April bug patch
history.text: Fixed shooting after rejoining a match following a heel flick and addressed Sae–Shidou chemistry.

history.title: Reo and Nagi update
history.text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.

history.title: Shidou rework
history.text: Shidou rework announced, including ball-compatible abilities.

history.title: Shidou penalty box patch
history.text: Shidou abilities disabled inside the penalty box at that date.

history.title: Shidou and Nagi update
history.text: Shidou style added, Nagi buffs and awakening ability announced.
